description: Create feature branch and verify baseline builds cleanly (TypeScript, Vite, tests all pass).
steps: Create and checkout branch feat/android-native-ui from main
Run bunx tsc --noEmit and confirm 0 errors
Run bun run build and confirm success
Run bun run test -- --run and note baseline results (30 pass, 3 pre-existing failures is acceptable)
acceptance_criteria: Branch feat/android-native-ui exists and is checked out
verification: bun run test -- --run shows no regressions
findings: Baseline verified: TypeScript 0 errors, Vite build succeeds (8.69s), Tests 30 pass / 3 pre-existing failures. Pre-existing test failures: (1) BuyCoinsSheet.test.tsx - 2 failures due to price format mismatch (tests expect currency symbol prefix like '₹49' but component renders plain numbers like '49'), (2) TipSheet.test.tsx - 1 failure for same currency formatting issue. These are not regressions. Also note: vitest teardown emits a harmless ReferenceError about 'listeners' - this is a bun/vitest compatibility quirk and does not affect test correctness.
